headline: Relief that feels personal, professional, and lasting.
subheadline: Time 4U Therapy Massage in Chickasha offers professional massage, bodywork, and wellness support in a calm setting designed around your comfort, goals, and everyday well-being.
heroImageAlt: Relaxing massage in a calm treatment room
servicesHeading: Massage and wellness care that fits your needs.
servicesIntro: Whether you need relief from chronic tension, a reset from a busy week, or a more nurturing wellness experience, Clara helps you choose the right approach without the guesswork.

serviceCards.title: Therapeutic Massage
serviceCards.body: Deep tissue, medical, orthopedic, prenatal, and lymphatic approaches for real relief and longer-lasting comfort.

serviceCards.title: Reflexology & Bodywork
serviceCards.alt: Calm spa setting with candles and towels
serviceCards.body: Targeted techniques to reduce stress, improve circulation, and help you feel more balanced.

serviceCards.title: Waxing & Wellness
serviceCards.body: Professional waxing and body care in a clean, comfortable environment that supports your routine.

processHeading: Personalized care designed to help you feel better.
processIntro: Relief, recovery, and calm should feel easy to access. That is why every visit is shaped around comfort, trust, and real results instead of a one-size-fits-all approach.

processSteps.title: Start with listening.
processSteps.body: Your concerns, comfort level, and goals guide the treatment plan from the very beginning.

processSteps.title: Receive targeted treatment.
processSteps.body: Each session uses the right balance of therapeutic pressure, technique, and attention.

processSteps.title: Leave feeling lighter.
processSteps.body: Supportive care helps you feel calmer, more mobile, and better equipped to take on the week.

giftBody: Gift certificates are available for every service. Whether it’s a birthday, a holiday, or simply showing someone you care — a massage from Time 4U is a gift that genuinely helps.
giftNote: Call or text to purchase a gift certificate in any amount.
contactBody: Call or text — appointments are scheduled 1–2 weeks ahead.
trustedBody: Clara Schoonover, L.M.T. serves Chickasha with professional therapeutic massage and bodywork focused on lasting relief and real comfort.
